## Affected component
Describe only the component or area. Do not include secrets or exploit steps.

## Proposed severity
Critical / High / Medium / Low / Informational

## One-line impact summary
Keep this non-sensitive.

## Private disclosure requested
- [ ] I have additional technical details that should not be published publicly.
- [ ] I have NOT included exploit code, credentials, private keys, secrets, or destructive reproduction steps in this issue.

## Safety confirmation
- [ ] I did not attempt a Mainnet launch.
- [ ] I did not disrupt production availability.
- [ ] I did not access private accounts or credentials.
- [ ] I did not test third-party infrastructure outside its rules.

A maintainer should acknowledge this intake and establish a private channel before requesting sensitive details.
